mia: quick async — what I did: landed the batchpacker refactor (WIP) and ran a 2k-seq perf sweep against main. p99 down ~9%, p50 up ~2% on long sequences. uploaded raw logs to /tmp/batchpack-2024-06-01.tar.gz for anyone who wants them
chen: nice! can you paste the perf summary link? wanna check memory trends :eyes:
mia: https://perf.redwood.internal/runs/1734028 — summary table is top, raw CSV in artifacts. memory looked stable for GPU-only runs, small malloc blips on host side
bench-bot: AUTO-BENCH: run_id=1734028000, model=redwood-base, batchpacker=true -> p50=18ms, p95=120ms, p99=240ms, tokens/sec=7800
alex: blocker: CI is flaking on r11-integ for the new batch aligner. reproducer is small but nondeterministic. infra-bot can you kick a run with the new docker image?
infra-bot: kicked pipeline #ci/1734028 with image redwood/batchpacker:canary-1734 — will report back, ETA ~12m
luis: question about KV: did batchpacker change hot-prefix caching? i saw slightly higher miss rate in the sweep which might explain p50 regression on short seqs
mia: good catch — batchpacker changes slot packing which delays some warmups. plan: add proactive KV warmup step for sources marked as "interactive". will try a canary with warmup=on this afternoon
chen: if you can, add a quick test to the microkernel harness: `--prefill-kv=10000 --seq=32` to simulate short interactive sessions
mia: will do, adding test + CR shortly. pinging @alex for review once it's up
alex: ack, fast review if it's small. also can we gate the warmup behind a runtime flag so Dedicated customers don't get unexpected extra token costs?
mia: yes — runtime flag `runtime.warmup.interactive=true/false`. default off for dedicated tiers
luis: perf note: eviction threshold tweak from 0.12 -> 0.08 reduced tail misses in my local runs. sharing numbers in the perf doc later
bench-bot: AUTO-BENCH: canary follow-up run_id=1734028288 -> warmup=true p50=16ms p95=95ms p99=210ms tokens/sec=8400 :tada:
alex: sweet. infra-bot, when CI passes could you roll a canary to staging so we can exercise multi-tenant routing?
infra-bot: staging canary scheduled: redwood/batchpacker:canary-1734 -> rolling to 3 hosts in us-west-2 at 14:30 UTC
mia: blockers summary: need CI flakes fixed (alex helping), want infra canary (infra-bot scheduled), will open CR in ~30m. today: add microkernel harness test, implement optional warmup flag, address small memory malloc blip if it shows up in canary
chen: pairing later for the harness test, 16:00 UTC works for me
luis: i'm around after 15:00 UTC to sanity-check KV metrics
alex: i'll try to get CI repro in the morning and do the quick review after lunch
mia: thanks team — short follow-ups only in this thread pls, i'll create a dedicated PR thread once it's opened :thumbsup:
